name: flatmeta
description: FlatMeta v2 monorepo: the world map you can own a piece of

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w flatmeta-api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w flatmeta-api && npm run build -w flatmeta-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w flatmeta-api -w flatmeta-web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w flatmeta-api -w flatmeta-web
